{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv')

# Check if missing values in flipper_length_mm are correlated with species
missing_flipper = df[df['flipper_length_mm'].isnull()]
print('Species distribution among missing flipper_length_mm:')
print(missing_flipper['species'].value_counts())

# Drop rows with missing flipper_length_mm for the mean calculation
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm'])

# Compute mean flipper length by species
mean_flipper_by_species = df_clean.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()
print('\nMean flipper length by species:')
print(mean_flipper_by_species)

# Identify species with highest mean
highest_species = mean_flipper_by_species.idxmax()
print(f'\nSpecies with highest mean flipper length: {highest_species}')"}
